subject: AWS Channel Private Offer — Reseller activation & ops checklist
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@resellco.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <aws-marketplace-partners@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to kick off Channel Private Offer activation for ACME

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ACME is ready to move forward with the Channel Private Offer (AWS CPPO) so we can transact through ResellCo. Attached is our initial entitlement spreadsheet (resellco_cppo_entitlements_v1.xlsx) with projected SKUs, seat counts and start dates.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm seller entity mapping for billing (we need invoices routed to ACME procurement)
- What evidence/certs do you need for the marketplace listing to go live (SOC2, SLA language, seller docs)?
- Can we target a PO + activation in the Nov billing window?

I copied AWS Partner Ops to keep them in the loop for marketplace-side requirements. Proposed meeting slots: Tue 10/20 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 10/21 14:00-15:00 PT.

Attachments: resellco_cppo_entitlements_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Partnerships | ResellCo
marta.ruiz@resellco.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@resellco.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <aws-marketplace-partners@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to kick off Channel Private Offer activation for ACME

Hi Marta — great to see this moving.

Thanks for the entitlement sheet, I skimmed it and it looks straightforward. Quick checklist from Redwood's side so we can unblock activation:
1) Seller entity mapping (who will receive the invoice): confirm legal entity + remit-to address
2) Signed PO (we can accept a PO via email or DocuSign)
3) Marketplace paperwork: we typically need the AWS "Make Public" seller docs and the commercial listing metadata (I asked AWS partners to confirm the final list)
4) Entitlement matrix + seat provisioning details (we'll use the attached spreadsheet as input to the entitlement service)

Lauren — can you take point on the seller entity mapping and invoice routing? Ben — please prepare the minimal onboarding bundle (SLA excerpt + seller contact sheet) we push to AWS.

Marta — Tue 10/20 10:00 PT works for me. If that slot is good for ACME we can do a 30m sync to align procurement steps. I will bring the mutual action plan draft to the call.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Head of Channels | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@resellco.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acmeinc.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to kick off Channel Private Offer activation for ACME — Ops checklist

Hi Marta / Olivia — looping in the ops checklist and the mutual action plan (attached: mutual_action_plan_RDW-0943.docx). Summary of what we need to finalize before AWS can activate CPPO:
- Signed PO or signed MPA referencing RDW-PP-2026-0943
- Seller entity mapping spreadsheet (legal name, tax ID, remit-to) — please confirm the exact invoice recipient for ACME
- Proof of insurance and SOC2 attestation (we can accept a link to published reports)
- Contact for entitlement provisioning (name + email for the person who will manage seat assignments)
- Confirmation on start date and initial quantity per SKU

Ben has compiled the minimal marketplace packet (SLA excerpt + seller contact sheet) and I also attached the AWS partner doc request (aws_make_public_docs_request.pdf) which lists the marketplace docs AWS will require to make the listing public.

Operational proposal:
- Tue 10/20 10:00 PT — 30m kickoff to confirm PO path and entity mapping
- 10/21 EOD — Redwood to upload seller packet to AWS partner portal
- 10/25 — Target activation window (subject to AWS partner review)

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_RDW-0943.docx; aws_make_public_docs_request.pdf

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@resellco.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, logan_wright@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to kick off Channel Private Offer activation for ACME — PO submitted

Thanks team — quick update after the call: ACME procurement signed the PO and I attached a signed copy (PO_ACME_RDW-0943_signed.pdf). ACME asks that invoices be sent to procurement@acmeinc.com and that Redwood set the seller-facing entitlement flag so ResellCo can provision seats on our side.

Next steps I need from Redwood:
- Confirm invoice entity mapping and that you can route invoices to procurement@acmeinc.com (legal name: ACME, Inc.; remit-to: 123 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA)
- Upload the marketplace packet to the partner portal (Lauren / Ben) by end of day 10/21
- Share the DocuSign link for the MPA if you want signatures pushed through that way (we can accept either)

I attached the signed PO and the updated entitlements sheet with final counts. Let me know if anything else is blocking.

Attachments: PO_ACME_RDW-0943_signed.pdf; resellco_cppo_entitlements_v1.xlsx (updated)

— Marta
